newsitem.title: DENMARK: NEW DANISH 5 PCT BOND SOLD AT 92.22 - DEALER.
newsitem.headline: NEW DANISH 5 PCT BOND SOLD AT 92.22 - DEALER.

text.p: The new Danish five percent state bond, due 2005, opened at a price of 92.22, yielding 6.19 percent a dealer said.

The National Bank had offered one billion crowns in the new paper at its opening price in the 1000 GMT auction and a total of five billion crowns during the course of the day. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
